paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar of Hagrunya and Rav Acha bar Tachlifa visited Rav Acha bar Rav Ika, in Rav Acha bar Yaakov’s place. Their host wanted to prepare a calf for them and showed them a knife. Rashi reads the term for the calf as “one-third grown.” Tachlifa asked, “Should we not respect the elder?”, meaning Acha bar Yaakov. Elazar: “Rava said a scholar may inspect for himself.” Elazar was punished: they began honoring the elder, and he should not slight it. Alternatively, Acha bar Yaakov was exceptional—very old and wise, Haddar 63a. Yuchasin copied poorly. Seder Ta'aniyot 24b: Rava decreed fasts; Elazar of Hagrunya reported a favorable dream. Rava understood that it was a favorable time, the people prayed, and rain came.
